thread:
mia: Heads-up 1: I've opened a short PR to add an 'Optimize quick cheat-sheet' that summarizes batching, KV prefetch, and common quant_profile choices. It includes tiny Python + Ruby examples and a compact three-row impact table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5481
ashwin: Nice. Can you paste the examples here so I can verify the parameter names?
mia: Python snippet: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
    model="rwd/opt-6b-q4",
    input="Short summary:",
    batch_size=4,
    kv_prefetch=True,
    quant_profile="q4_128"
)
print(resp.output)
```
mia: Ruby snippet (micro):
```ruby
require "redwood"
client = Redwood::Client.new
resp = client.generate(
  model: "rwd/opt-6b-q4",
  input: "Short summary:",
  batch_size: 4,
  kv_prefetch: true,
  quant_profile: "q4_128"
)
puts resp.output
```
sam: Love the small Ruby example 1. Could we also include a one-line note about the SDK shape change (resp.output vs resp.text) so readers don't get confused?
mia: Added a short note in the doc: "SDK response field is `output` (not `text`) in v0.12+"
leila: For the compact table, please avoid precise numbers. Use relative buckets like: "latency: +/0/-, cost: +/0/-" for q8 vs q4 at batch sizes 1/4/8. Call out that this is workload-dependent.
mia: Will do. Proposed MD table snippet: 
```
| batch | q4_128 (latency/cost) | q8_512 (latency/cost) |
|-------|-----------------------|-----------------------|
| 1     | - / -                | + / +                |
| 4     | 0 / -                | + / 0                |
| 8     | 0 / -                | + / 0                |
```
ashwin: Small nit: table rows need consistent padding otherwise the Markdown linter flags it. doc-bot will catch.
jordana: Also add a one-line migration checklist for Dedicated: "Pin quant_profile per model version and run a canary on 5% traffic before rolling". That prevents surprises when quant profiles change across a rollout.
mia: Added that under "Dedicated/Private" with a short checklist bullet.
ashwin: You mentioned broken links last time 1. Any new ones?
mia: Found two stale references in old nav: `/optimize/quant-profiles` and `/optimize/batches`. I'm proposing two redirects in mkdocs.yml to keep old external links working: 
```yaml
- from: /optimize/quant-profiles
  to: /optimize/quantization/quick-sheet/
- from: /optimize/batches
  to: /optimize/batching/overview/
```
doc-bot: LINT: markdown-table-style in optimize/quantization/quick-sheet/index.md: expected pipe alignment.
doc-bot: NOTE: mkdocs-redirects validated for new entries.
sam: Can we merge the PR without the table alignment fix? I think it's low-risk and we should get the cheat-sheet out. We'll follow up with a small fix.
leila: Agree but create a follow-up issue so it doesn't fall through the cracks.
mia: Done: created issue #840 to fix table formatting + add a crossref to benchmarks. Updated PR description to reference the issue.
doc-bot: CI: docs build fail on first run, second run OK after minor spacing patch. Preview: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/5481/ (cheat-sheet + snippets render)
ashwin: Quick review: examples ok, redirects make sense, migration note good. LGTM after tiny spacing fix.
mia: Merged. I'll watch the preview and close #840 after the follow-up commit. Thanks all. :ship:
